program_name: Bachelor of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Hons)

fees.notes: Programme is no longer offered: absent from Nilai's current programme list (nilai.edu.my sitemap, checked 2026-09-18) and from the official 'Fee Structure & Scholarships 2023 For International Students' (https://www.nilai.edu.my/sites/default/files/e-brochure/FEE%20SRUCTURE%20%26%20SCHOLARSHIP%20INTERNATIONAL.pdf). Last official published tuition was in Nilai's 2015 Undergraduate Fee Structure (archived: https://web.archive.org/web/20180127211836id_/http://www.nilai.edu.my/sites/default/files/Undergraduate%20fee%20structure%202015%20-%20v5-09-14.pdf): RM65,280 for the 4-year engineering bachelors (128 credits, RM510/credit) and RM30,600 for the 2.5-year engineering diplomas (90 credits, RM340/credit); superseded and not used as a current fee. Fee remains unpublished.
